notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello

First, we want to thank everyone for your support and patience. We know our communication hasn’t been as frequent lately, and we apologize for that-we’ve been hard at work making Hollow Home the best it can be.

Heartfelt Thank You for 30,000 Wishlists!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/32c62a4dc53d27b27f27b7563ae13c8b14b05ba0.png

We’re absolutely thrilled to announce that Hollow Home has now been added to over 30,000 wishlists on Steam! 
This is a milestone we could only dream of when we started this journey, and it’s all thanks to you. Whether you’ve been with us since the very beginning or you’ve just discovered Hollow Home, we want to extend a warm welcome and a huge thank you for your support. Every wishlist, every comment, and every bit of feedback means the world to us. It’s your passion and enthusiasm that keeps us going, even on the toughest days.

Kickstarter Campaign Coming Soon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/e6f3b3c400add41475514b7878100f9f5f25fbc5.png

We have some exciting news to share as we’re currently working behind the scenes on a Kickstarter campaign for Hollow Home. 
While we’re not quite ready to reveal all the details just yet, we wanted to give you a heads-up so you can be among the first to know when we launch. Following our campaign now and getting notified at launch will make a huge difference for us, helping Hollow Home reach a wider audience and giving us the momentum we need to make the game even better. 
We can’t wait to share more with you soon!

Demo is back! 

Once again, our demo is available for you to try! If you haven’t had a chance yet, now is the perfect time to experience a slice of what we’ve been building. For those of you who have already played the demo, we’ve made a number of improvements, such as UI/UX enhancements, updated animations, and a bunch of bug fixes.

We would love for you to explore the changes and let us know what you think.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362070/Hollow_Home/

A New Release Window: Looking Ahead to Next Year

We know many of you have been eagerly awaiting the release of Hollow Home this year, and we truly appreciate your patience and excitement. 
After a lot of careful thought and discussion, we’ve made the difficult decision to move the release to next year. We want to be completely transparent with you as our vision for Hollow Home has grown, and we want to make sure we deliver the experience you deserve. Taking this extra time will allow us to polish every detail, add more content, and ensure that Hollow Home is as immersive and memorable as possible. We understand this might be disappointing, but we firmly believe it’s the right choice for the game and for our community.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/f15f4a28379590b26f222d3e64bcaa608f8d21d6.png


Thank you for standing by us and for believing in Hollow Home. Your support inspires us every single day. We’re more excited than ever about what’s ahead, and we can’t wait to share more updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes stories with you in the coming months.

notes.title: Updates on game, events and our studio
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

May has been a whirlwind for us at Twigames, packed with back-to-back conferences, traveling, and intense development work. We want to share with you our journey and achievements from the recent Digital Dragons in Poland and the Nordic Game Conference in Sweden. Despite the challenges, we're pushing forward and have some updates about Hollow Home.

Here's what you'll find in this announcement:

 Digital Dragons and Nordic Game conferences
 Challenges our studio faces
 New content additions


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/4e935258ba425de0226e13ef0c08795010be4b38.png
Digital Dragons and Nordic Game conferences
At Digital Dragons, we had the opportunity to pitch Hollow Home to industry professionals, who shared with Nastya great advice and comments on the project, that will help us to create a better experience for you. She also had an opportunity to listen to Swen Vincke talk on the challenges Larian Studios encountered during Baldur’s Gate 3 development, which was uplifting, knowing that every success is paved with challenges. Meanwhile, at Nordic Game, Nastya engaged in Pitch Battles, culminating in Hollow Home’s victory. Similar to Digital Dragons, these pitches were evaluated by industry veterans.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/23325b71e3cce2934f85fa2ca8597321528d7bbc.png

Challenges our studio faces
Indie game development presents unique hurdles. While solo developers contend with time constraints and often work after regular job hours, studio-based teams face exponentially escalating challenges. Check out Valerii's interview at Premortem Games for insights into these obstacles:
Hollow Home by Ukrainian studio Twigames tells the story of how the war affects everyday life

New content additions
Despite the substantial challenges outlined in the Premortem Games interview, we persistently enhance our game. While we refrain from revealing too much about Max's story, rest assured, we're constantly refining it. For now, we want to share some GIFs showcasing recently implemented bird mechanics and weather systems. These additions promise to immerse you further into the captivating world of Hollow Home and significantly enrich our storytelling experience.

https://i.imgur.com/N2L1sPZ.gif

https://i.imgur.com/Sp6abiH.gif

https://i.imgur.com/Sz0v2xq.gif




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/5acc106fb36b0815dc7896c114668978e21f6d41.png

Our game is driven by emotional and human connections. Building upon this, we want to get to know you better, your stories and life events, and receive feedback. Therefore, we would like to invite you to our Discord server to join us on our journey and share your thoughts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/f15f4a28379590b26f222d3e64bcaa608f8d21d6.png

Looking forward to sharing more updates with you soon!
Twigames Team

notes.title: New Hollow Home OST, Digital Dragons conference and Nordic Game 2024
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

For starters, thank you for following our news. We appreciate your engagement in what’s going on with Hollow Home. Today we are happy to let you know that we're attending two major conferences this May. Come meet us!

A quick rundown of what you’ll find below:

 New OST
 Digital Dragons conference
 Nordic Game 2024 conference

New OST
As you know from our previous news, we take great pride in creating unique experiences for you to explore. Thanks to Danylo’s hard work and emotions poured into our project, we can introduce you to Hollow Home's new music piece. You can listen to it in the video below.

We can’t wait to hear your opinion on it.

[previewyoutube=1hbLsagejS0;full][/previewyoutube]



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/791c30ba9b08a1705a3524ccd71a7d55b50ec9e5.png

Digital Dragons conference
We'll be attending Digital Dragons, one of the largest gaming industry conferences. Located in ICE Kraków Congress Centre, Kraków, Poland, the conference will run from May 19th till 21st and gather many industry professionals. Our business artist Nastya will be there to meet and answer any questions you may have. 

Nordic Game 24 conference
Right after Digital Dragons, Nastya will head to Nordic Game 2024, a leading games conference in Europe that takes place in Malmö, Sweden. The conference will take place May 21-24, and it will be located at the Slagthuset. For more information, check out the Nordic Game 2024 website.

We’ll be very happy if you come and say hello to us at any of the events and check out Hollow Home. Your encouragement means a lot to us and is the best way to support Twigames.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/5acc106fb36b0815dc7896c114668978e21f6d41.png
Our game is driven by emotional and human connections. Building upon this, we want to get to know you better, your stories and life events, and receive feedback. Therefore, we would like to invite you to our Discord server to join us on our journey and share your thoughts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/f15f4a28379590b26f222d3e64bcaa608f8d21d6.png

notes.title: Latest from Twigames, awards, nominations, conferences and PAX East
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Recently, we've been extremely busy working, planning, and attending events that we can finally share with you. We have been nominated for awards, began new collaborations, attended conferences and planned for the future, so tune in to find out what's been happening at Twigames.


Quick run down what you’ll find:

 Games Gathering Conference
 Game Connection Awards
 Twigames x PAX East
 Galaktus x Twigames co-operation
 Hollow Home Discord server


Games Gathering Conference
This past weekend, we attended the Games Gathering Conference, where we won awards in two categories: "Best Conference Game" and "Game Star". We were pleased that Hollow Home received broad industry recognition and appreciation. This is a great success on behalf of our team, and we're proud  that Ukrainian games and the game market is growing despite the difficult circumstances our country has faced over the last two years. We look forward to it developing further and seeing what games it brings to the international gaming stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/bfe99216d67f48752f0d6418c41272d348c1f192.jpg

Game Connection Awards
We got more great news, Hollow Home got nominated for the Game Connection Awards in three categories: Best Storytelling, Grand Award, and Best Development Team. The team at Twigames is excited about the results of the nominations, but also about the fact that our small Ukrainian studio and our game is getting worldwide recognition. 

It is beyond rewarding that the story that has hit our homeland is getting acknowledged by a broader audience and that Ukrainian games and studios are getting worldwide acknowledgment despite obstacles faced. We're very grateful to be able to create and present our game internationally, and get nominated for our hard work.  

PAX East
Hollow Home is heading to PAX East, one of the largest gaming events in the world, with expert panels, game demos, tournaments, an expo hall filled with games, and more. Our game will be available as part of the Galaktus Publishing Booth (No. 18084) during the event in Boston, US. The event will run from March 21st until March 24th, and we strongly encourage you to visit and play our game. More info on the event can be found on PAX’s website.

Galaktus & Twigames
As mentioned above, we're heading to PAX East, where we will be a part of Galaktus's Publishing Booth. We began a cooperation with Galaktus Agency that made showcasing our game at this event possible. They will take care of our publishing, marketing and PR-related activities. We look forward to future cooperation and can't wait to see what we can create together. 

Hollow Home Discord server
Our game is driven by emotional and human connections. Building upon this, we want to get to know you better, your stories and life events, and receive feedback. Therefore, we would like to invite you to our Discord server to join us on our journey and share your own thoughts.

We look forward to meeting you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513379/f15f4a28379590b26f222d3e64bcaa608f8d21d6.png

Follow us on X (Twitter) to stay up-to-date with our latest news!

Thanks for tuning in. We look forward to sharing more exciting news soon!
